Label: Short Oxford-Liverpool Inventory of Feelings and Experiences
Description: Short Oxford-Liverpool Inventory of Feelings and Experiences (sO-LIFE). Measures schizotypy (unusual experiences, cognitive disorganisation, introvertive anhedonia, impulsive nonconformity). 43 items, yes/no. Reference: Mason, O., Linney, Y., & Claridge, G. (2005). Short scales for measuring schizotypy. Schizophrenia Research, 78(2-3), 293-296.
